methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN Treaty Collection (https://treaties.un.org) hosts the United Nations Treaty Series (UNTS), certified copies, depositary notifications and monthly statements. It is a legacy ASP.NET WebForms application (.aspx pages, __doPostBack, ctl00$ContentPlaceHolder naming), not a modern SPA.

## Search
An advanced search exists at Pages/AdvanceSearch.aspx?tab=UNTS&clang=_en, but querying it relies on WebForms post-back state (__VIEWSTATE) rather than clean GET parameters, so it is not straightforwardly scrapable via a URL template. More scrapable entry points are the server-rendered listing pages: LatestTreaties.aspx, LatestVolumes.aspx, MSDatabase.aspx and CumulativeIndexes.aspx.

## Filters
No clean URL-parameter filters; filtering is via the post-back advanced search form. Volume numbers are encoded in the PDF paths.

## Download
UNTS volume PDFs and notification PDFs are directly downloadable under /doc/Publication/ (e.g. /doc/Publication/UNTS/Volume%203230/v3230.pdf, /doc/Publication/CTC/Ch_X_22.pdf, /doc/Publication/CN/2026/CN.254.2026-Eng.pdf). Individual treaty detail pages are reached via post-back from listings (record-page flow).

## Metadata & Enrichment
No REST/JSON layer detected. Metadata is in server-rendered tables and record pages. Enrichment mode is none.

## Limitations
The listing/volume pages are server-rendered and their PDFs are directly harvestable. However, keyword/advanced search and per-treaty detail navigation depend on ASP.NET post-back state, so a stateless scraper cannot query them via a simple URL; that path needs __VIEWSTATE replay or a headless browser.
